main_text.p: m. Fuscum, quasi ex Calore aduftum, Gen.30.32.
חַמָּה f. Calor, Sol, à Calefaciendo, Job.30.28. Aff. מְחַמָּתוֹ A calore ejus, Psal.17.7.

חַמָּנִים m. p. Subdiales ftatuæ, quasi Solares vel Soli expofitæ, Jesa.17.8. & 27.9. Aff. חַמָּנֵיכֶם Subdiales ftatuas veftras, Levit.26.30. ubi R. Salomon: Idola erant, quæ ponebant fuper tecta, & quia foli erant expofita, appellabant ea חַמָּנִים: Idem fcribit Ezech.6.4. & Ab. Efra: בֵּית־חַמָּנִים Domus vel facella erant facta inftar curruum, id eft, fornicata, ad cultum folis, Jes.17.8. Vide 2.Par. 33. v.4. & 34.4. & 2.Reg.23.11.12.

חָמַס Abftulit, Abripuit violenter, Violentiâ ufus fuit: Violentiam, Vim fecit, Injuriâ affecit: Præt. חָמְסוּ תּוֹרָתִי Vim faciunt legi meæ, vel, Injuriâ afficiunt legem meam, Ezech.22.26. Futur. יֶחְמָס Violenter auferet, Vi abripiet, Job.15.33. Thren.2.6. עָלַי תַּחְמְסוּ Quas contra me violenter rapitis, id eft, iniquè comminifcimini, Job.21.27. Niph. Præter.: נֶחְמְסוּ עֲקָבֶיךָ Violenter aufe-rentur veftigia tua, id eft, folea tua, Jer.31.22. hoc eft, Dis-calceata ibi in captivitatem: Confer Jesa.20.

חָמָס masc. Vis, Violentia, Injuria, Rapina: עֵד חָמָס Teftis injuriâ, id eft, iniquus, injurius, Levit.23.1. Conftr. וְחָמַס־אָרֶץ Et violentiam terræ, Hab.2.8. Aff. חֲמָסוֹ Injuria ejus, Psal.7.17. Plural. מְאִישׁ חֲמָסִים A viro violentiarum, id eft, violentiffimo, Psal.140.2.
תַּחְמָס[?] m. Hirundo, juxta quosdam, Levit.11.16. Kimchi in lib. Rad. fcribit; quòd fit Avis immunda, fic dicta, quòd alias aves violenter rapit. Avis rapax, juxta Jonathanem, ut Noctua, Bubo.
חָמֵץ Fermentatus fuit: Præter.: כִּי לֹא חָמֵץ Quum nondum fermentata effet, Exod.12.39. Participia vide inter Nomina. Infin. עַד־חֲמָצְתוֹ[?] Ufque ad fermen-tari

page.notes: Large woodcut-style initials on חָמַס and חָמֵץ are set as large Hebrew letters; the headwords are copied as printed. The Hebrew of the entry opening with "תַּחְמָס" and the infinitive at the foot of the page (עַד־חֲמָצְתוֹ) are hard to read in the scan and are marked [?]. The dash in בֵּית־חַמָּנִים is uncertain. Levit.23.1 is read from a small figure and may be misprinted. The running head "חמ" is the printed Hebrew letters, and the page number 339 is printed at top left. The entry "Ufque ad fermen-tari" ends the page in italic.
